prior_exploration.user_pilot: EXPLORED_PROMPT_ONLY; source unavailable; not executed or treated as learned evidence
prior_exploration.official_cpu_smoke: 20 updates batch8; train/result PASS; plot dependency failures
prior_exploration.gpu_dev_smoke: 20 updates batch128 seed0; pipeline only; no TEST

architecture.task: S3 arbitrary elements; left cumulative product

training.optimizer: upstream Muon hidden matrices plus AdamW
training.checkpoint_selection: final scheduled update only, no TEST selection

resource_budget.condition: seed0 scheduled training complete AND DEV32 all-prefix >=0.90 AND final-quarter >=0.95; only remaining global budget; same schedule; no extension

input_law: independent uniform over all six group elements; longest sequences reused for prefixes

evaluation.nonfinite: entire output checked; nonfinite is first failure and execution marked
evaluation.initial_state: zero; untrained initial zero state not scored; BOS transition/read separately reported
evaluation.bos: one BOS token before t=1; codec applied also to BOS write; BOS excluded from tau
evaluation.read_boundary: after every token write, represented Z+decoded residual
evaluation.coordinate_system: physical; no retained cumulative gauge; normalized q/k and full original decoder
evaluation.primary_sample: all 512 TEST sequences, never baseline-conditioned filtering
evaluation.empirical_horizon: grid restricted; censored lower bound, never infinity
evaluation.simultaneous_family: all predeclared arms times7 horizons times3 possible seeds; Bonferroni exact upper binomial bounds
evaluation.seed_variation: separate strata, do not pool model seeds

calibration.basis: per-head covariance of local base INT4 self-update writeback residual; top eigenvectors rank1/2/4; sign canonical
calibration.mixed: CAL error energy times next-transition column squared norm; stable index tie; not DAMP reproduction
calibration.ranges: per-head dynamic maxabs per write; FP32 scale stored
calibration.candidate_selection: no TEST-dependent selection; all frozen arms retained, budget frontiers descriptive with simultaneous bounds

storage.format: actual uint8 packed payload, per-head FP32 maxabs scales, little endian, LSB-first
storage.rounding: ties-to-even; SplitMix64 stochastic with persistent seed+counter
storage.shared: canonical codec config + fixed basis bytes + any transition/readout table used
storage.model_weights: common fixed checkpoint reported separately; not candidate-specific cache; no model-VRAM claim

restrictions: no coefficient quantization in learned primary
no gold/native/future input in candidate update
